articles.summary: GROSSE POINTE FARMS, Mich., Aug. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Saga Communications, Inc. (Nasdaq - SGA) (the “Company” or “Saga”) today reported that net revenue decreased 6.5% to $26.4 million for the quarter ended June 30, 2026 compared to $28.2 million for the same period last year.
articles.title: Saga Communications, Inc. Reports 2nd Quarter 2026 Results
